Class AspectJJCacheConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.cache.annotation.AbstractCachingConfiguration
org.springframework.cache.jcache.config.AbstractJCacheConfiguration
org.springframework.cache.aspectj.AspectJJCacheConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, ImportAware
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @Role(2) public class AspectJJCacheConfiguration extends AbstractJCacheConfiguration
`@Configuration` 类，用于注册启用标准 JSR-107 注解的基于 AspectJ 的注解驱动缓存管理所需的 Spring 基础设施 Bean。
Since:
4.1
Author:
Stephane Nicoll
